items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: My thought about Frog Eye Moore... I began to search through the records, and I ran across Frog Eye Moore.

ctx.x: I always get a wonderful kick out of some of the titles of Jelly's tombs, you know. You could almost write a book on the titles. I suppose that every title has a... was a stepping stone somewhere along his career.
Titles are... arrived at in a kidding way sometimes. My thought about Frog Eye Moore, you know. The real thing is Frog Eye Moore. F-R-O-G, I...

items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: They changed that. But my belief is that some guy that played with him was... had bulgey eyes like a frog, you know. Yeah. See, and they say, oh, there's old Frog Eye there. We'll name this after him, see. Frog Eye Moore.

ctx.x: Yes. But that's right. I remember that before.

We'll name this after him, see. Frog Eye Moore. Yes. But, what's his name? Smith in Brooklyn. He claims that Frog Eye Moore was a contortionist. Of course, that sounds plausible, you know. A contortionist does dress up like a frog very used to a long time ago. Yeah. So he could have been named after a contortionist by the name of Moore or…
I think your answer's better, because the original things, it wasn't Frog Eye Moore. It was not a name, Moore. It was M-O-R-E.
